content.short: Tonkeeper is a self custody TON wallet for payments, swaps, staking, NFTs, and access to apps across the network.
content.description: Tonkeeper is one of the main self custody wallets built specifically for The Open Network. It gives users a place to store TON and jettons, send payments, manage NFTs, swap supported assets, and join staking from inside a single wallet app. The product also supports QR based transfers and connections to decentralized applications, which makes it useful as both an everyday wallet and a gateway into the broader TON ecosystem. Its role is closer to a core native wallet than a general multi-chain app with partial TON support.
content.meta: Tonkeeper helps users manage TON assets, payments, swaps, staking, NFTs, and app connections through a wallet built for the network.
